title: When do you need to make new Meta ads?
description: When do you need to make new Meta ads?
transcript: How often should you create new Facebook ads? The truth is there isn't a perfect number and different businesses will have different creative volume requirements. But what I'd recommend you do is set a schedule and try and stick to it. So work out in advance, I think I'm going to need four new creatives each month. You can always adjust that according to performance and according to what's realistic. Typically, we will do more testing and produce more creatives when results aren't very good. We need to put more budget into experimental things to try and find new winners. But when results are good, we might then pair that back and spend less resources on trying to make new stuff and more on just trying to amplify our winners.
